sourceAuthorities: social gameplay and NPC interaction instructions

resolvedFindings.finding: Faction register contains role-implied labels but no stable faction references.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Prohibit ID synthesis from occupations, titles, species, role tags, or implied organizations.

resolvedFindings.finding: Existing faction schema stores member NPC IDs directly.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Introduce explicit membership records and treat arrays as compatibility indexes until verified migration.

resolvedFindings.finding: Draft source reaction and standing profiles could be mistaken for global constants.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Require bindable profile definitions and preserve them only as examples/defaults.

resolvedFindings.finding: Faction standing, personal relationship, and influence overlap linguistically.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Lock separate aggregates and delegated F009 relationships.

resolvedFindings.finding: Faction progression could be misread as membership, rank, office, ownership, equipment, or permission.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Make all such grants explicit separate records and authorization decisions.

resolvedFindings.finding: Permanent organization or world changes could bypass Projects.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Require Project authority for permanent political, economic, territorial, environmental, divine, or market effects.
